patches.title: Exact Name Match
patches.principle: Only pick up an object if its displayed name exactly matches the target object in the task description.
patches.when_to_apply: When you see an object that might be the target.

patches.title: Return to Start After Search
patches.principle: If you have searched multiple locations without finding the target, return to your starting surface and re-examine it.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have exhausted several areas and still lack the target.

patches.title: Resume Search After Placement
patches.principle: After placing an object, check if the task requires more of the same object; if so, resume searching for the next one.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have just placed an object in a multi-object task.
